select a.preset_id, a.camera_id, a.preset_num, a.preset_name, a.preset_type, a.creator_user, a.creator_time, a.is_use, a.preset_img, a.inspection_postion, a.collect_status, a.calibration_status, a.preset_ptz from t_camera_preset a where 1 = 1 and a.camera_id = #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
